description: utopia-php/auth: password hashes, proofs, session store, JWT issuers and verifiers, OAuth2 server values, WebAuthn passkeys.

hash.hash.doc: $hash->hash(value); salted algorithms are masked per step and cross-verified

hash.once.doc: new <Hash>(), setOptions(options), then verify(value, hash_value) or hash(value): one call, for fuzzing

verifier.check.doc: new Verifiers\Symmetric(secret, ...)->verify(token ?? an HS256 JWS of header and claims) at `now`: one call, for fuzzing

proof.new.doc: new Code(length?) | Token(length?) | Phrase() | Password(hashes: {name: hash handle})

mask.reason: generated secrets are random; cases check them with fixture.matches / fixture.strlen

password.create_hash.doc: Password::createHash(type, options) as a hash handle

issuer.new.doc: new Jwt|RefreshToken(secret, issuer, key_id?) or AccessToken|IdToken(private_key, public_key, issuer, key_id?)

mask.reason: random; cases check its shape with fixtures
fresh RSA keys; cases sign and verify with them across runtimes
